subs: not just from birth to death,
every good deed we ever do
is done through us by Vayudeva.

caption.title: Who Really Does Your Good Deeds? 🙏 | Madhwa16
caption.description: From the first day of the year to the last, from dawn to night — not just from birth to death, but from beginningless time until liberation — every good deed we do is done through us by Vayudeva, the chief life-force. A humbling thought for Madhwa Jayanti. 🙏 From the Madhwa Jayanti discourse "The Divine Glory of Jagadguru Sriman Madhvacharya's Incarnation" by Sri Satyatmateertha Shripadangalavaru (Sri Uttaradimath Adhyatmavani).

subs: the God who made this whole world
If the maker of this ordered world
had even a little worry, effort,
the world would fall into chaos.

caption.title: Why God Must Be Utterly Flawless 🙏 | Madhwa16
caption.description: Look at how orderly this world is. Madhwacharya showed, from the scriptures, that the God who made it must be infinite and perfect in every quality. If its creator had even a trace of worry, laziness, weakness, ignorance or discouragement, the world would fall into chaos. 🙏 From the Madhwa Jayanti discourse "The Divine Glory of Jagadguru Sriman Madhvacharya's Incarnation" by Sri Satyatmateertha Shripadangalavaru (Sri Uttaradimath Adhyatmavani).

subs: Ordinary people can never do it.
His glories can't even be counted,
Still, it is our own duty.
If we never reflect on him,
He has given us endless blessings.
To remember him is our duty,
and it is what uplifts us.

caption.title: Why We Remember Madhwacharya 🙏 | Madhwa16
caption.description: Even if the gods spent their whole lifespans, they could not describe the glory of Sri Madhwacharya — his glories cannot even be counted. Yet remembering him is our duty. We have received endless blessings from him, and remembering him, even a little, is what uplifts us. Happy Madhwa Jayanti. 🙏 From the Madhwa Jayanti discourse "The Divine Glory of Jagadguru Sriman Madhvacharya's Incarnation" by Sri Satyatmateertha Shripadangalavaru (Sri Uttaradimath Adhyatmavani).

subs: Like the universe in His tiny mouth,
revealed it, with scripture as proof:
it is serving all kinds of people.
Just as paying tax is unavoidable,

caption.title: Helping Others Is Like Paying Tax 🙏 | Madhwa16
caption.description: Krishna's words are small, but each one holds a universe. Take the word "karma" in the Gita. Madhwacharya revealed, with scripture as proof, that karma isn't just ritual — it is serving all kinds of people. Just as paying tax is unavoidable, helping others is unavoidable too, in measure, like a tax. 🙏 From the Madhwa Jayanti discourse "The Divine Glory of Jagadguru Sriman Madhvacharya's Incarnation" by Sri Satyatmateertha Shripadangalavaru (Sri Uttaradimath Adhyatmavani).

subs: As far as you are able,
in whatever way your life allows.
and the lowly with tender care.
and see that service as worship
of the Lord who dwells within.
Then the Lord will give you

caption.title: Serve Everyone — That Is Worship 🙏 | Madhwa16
caption.description: Seeing God isn't about seeking liberation on your own. As far as you are able, help others: serve good people with devotion, help ordinary people with love, and treat even the lowly with tender care. See that service as worship of the Lord who dwells within everyone — serving people is serving God. Then the Lord will give you His darshan. 🙏 From the Madhwa Jayanti discourse "The Divine Glory of Jagadguru Sriman Madhvacharya's Incarnation" by Sri Satyatmateertha Shripadangalavaru (Sri Uttaradimath Adhyatmavani).
